title: Voices of displacement: Testimony based multimodal pedagogies.
summary: This book documents the two year collaborative work that led to the creation of the VOLARE Digital Repository, which hosts video testimonies of, and about, displacement. It seeks to theoretically and methodologically frame how the repository came into being and why the team regards it as a meaningful and politically situated educational proposition. All texts are available in English, as well as in their original languages: Bulgarian, Greek, or French.
